body.name: \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau):=\ell\min\{1,[m\log(2m)/n]^{\varkappa}\}\). It is the coordinatewise known-envelope Hall plug-in benchmark obtained by familywise calibration over \(2m\) cell arms before mixture inversion. Carpentier and Kim (2015) write their absolute tail remainder as order \(y^{-\alpha(1+\beta_{\mathrm{CK}})}\); the present relative envelope implies absolute order \(y^{-(\alpha+\beta)}\), so \(\beta_{\mathrm{CK}}=\beta/\alpha\) and their exponent \(\beta_{\mathrm{CK}}/(2\beta_{\mathrm{CK}}+1)\) becomes \(\beta/(2\beta+\alpha)\), whose uniform worst case on \(\alpha\in[1,4]\) is \(\varkappa=\beta/(2\beta+4)\).
